LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: Introduce Someone with 叫, 姓, and 是
LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Introduce someone by name, surname, or identity.
LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: 叫, 姓 and 是 are used as verbs and equate two nouns in a sentence. 姓 comes only before a family name. 叫 comes before a given name or a full name. 是 says what someone is. Put 不 before them to say no.

text.traditional: A：她是誰？ B：她是新同學。
text.simplified: A：她是谁？ B：她是新同学。
text.pinyin: A: Tā shì shéi? B: Tā shì xīn tóngxué.
text.english: A: Who is she? B: She is a new classmate.

text.traditional: 她是日本人，她不是台灣人。
text.simplified: 她是日本人，她不是台湾人。
text.pinyin: Tā shì Rìběn rén, tā bú shì Táiwān rén.
text.english: She is Japanese. She is not Taiwanese.

text.traditional: 她不姓李，她姓小林，叫小林友美。
text.simplified: 她不姓李，她姓小林，叫小林友美。
text.pinyin: Tā bú xìng Lǐ, tā xìng Xiǎolín, jiào Xiǎolín Yǒuměi.
text.english: Her surname is not Li. Her surname is Xiaolin; her name is Xiaolin Youmei.

LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleEnglish: Ask a Yes/No Question with 嗎
LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Turn a statement into a yes-or-no question with one ending word.
LESSON_ONE_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: Add 嗎 at the very end of the statement, without any change in order. Nothing inside the sentence moves. The listener answers yes or no.

text.traditional: A：他是日本人嗎？ B：他不是日本人，他是台灣人。
text.simplified: A：他是日本人吗？ B：他不是日本人，他是台湾人。
text.pinyin: A: Tā shì Rìběn rén ma? B: Tā bú shì Rìběn rén, tā shì Táiwān rén.
text.english: A: Is he Japanese? B: He is not Japanese; he is Taiwanese.

text.pinyin: Gāo xiānsheng jiào Jiālè ma?
text.english: Is Mr. Gao called Jiale?

text.pinyin: Tā máng ma?
text.english: Is he busy?
